photos.file: An Indian Courser Chick - A rare spot for me (49874638047).jpg
photos.desc: Indian Courser chick a week or two old. Tiny less than my son's palm and beautiful. These birds are resident the whole year round and can be seen easily. But spotting a chick has been tough for many.
